source: The method combines two ideas. First, most values use vector-wise ZXNAME0000XZ quantization with separate normalization constants for inner products. Second, feature dimensions identified as outliers are separated and processed in higher precision. The paper reports that more than 99.9% of values can still participate in the 8-bit path while outlier dimensions use a 16-bit matrix multiplication.
zh: 该方法结合了两种想法。首先，大多数值使用矢量 ZXNAME0000XZ 量化以及内积的单独归一化常数。其次，被识别为异常值的特征维度被分离并以更高的精度进行处理。该论文报告称，超过 99.9% 的值仍然可以参与 8 位路径，而离群维度则使用 16 位矩阵乘法。
